ranges.label: Help and VCL support
ranges.evidence: THelpManager and THelpViewerNode VMTs; interface dispatch in 0x41ED54; GUID query at 0x41E9AF. Original RTL/VCL packaging of HelpIntfs is grouped with desktop framework support here.

ranges.label: Dialog implementation
ranges.evidence: TMessageForm at 0x42EAAC inherits Forms.TForm. Dialog creation/control setup at 0x42F0D4 and 0x42FAFC; final helper ends at 0x4300E4.

ranges.label: Theme services
ranges.evidence: TThemeServices VMT at 0x44C114; theme part/state mapping at 0x44C690 and non-client control painting at 0x44CA1C. Final helper ends at 0x44CC3E.

ranges.label: JPEG codec and unit cleanup
ranges.evidence: 0x4608E0 checks codec version 62 and decompressor size 464; DCT at 0x4715E8, Huffman construction at 0x4722B4, compressor setup at 0x472570. Final routine 0x4725B4 unregisters TJPEGImage and ends at 0x4725F4.

ranges.label: User-directory helper
ranges.evidence: Maintained GetGameUserDirectory; native SHGetSpecialFolderLocation and SpaceRangersHD path construction. Logical Globals header placement does not establish original unit ownership.

ranges.label: Turn-calculation UI wrappers
ranges.evidence: Seven maintained wrappers call the separate native ThreadCalc implementation; their original source unit remains unresolved.

ranges.label: Film object information and serialization
ranges.evidence: 0x506A48 references Error in procedure TEObjInfo.LoadFromStar; 0x5086C8 reads serialized object data through TBufEC and ends at 0x509024.

ranges.label: Mod discovery and installation
ranges.evidence: 0x53125C and 0x5321A8 process install.txt, CFG/Main.dat, CFG/CacheData.dat and ModuleInfo.txt. Classified as mod infrastructure without claiming an exact original unit split.

ranges.label: Arcade weapon support
ranges.evidence: 0x562E34 updates weapon effects; 0x563754 queues per-weapon graphics resources. Both are contiguous with the anchored ab_W01 implementation; trailing literal pools are excluded from byte counts.

ranges.label: Ship dialogue actions
ranges.evidence: Talk.Tranclucator.Options.*, ShipDismissAct and quest-letter actions. Final helper 0x61AFF4 builds a dialogue choice using TMessageLoopGI, CurrentScript.CurrentAnswer and callback 0x61AFB0; ends at 0x61B071.

ranges.label: Script action execution
ranges.evidence: 0x678DD0, 0x679198 and 0x67970C dispatch item/ship actcode and reference explicit script action error messages.

ranges.label: Arcade space generation and drawing
ranges.evidence: Ship.HS.*, Ship.X.* and Ship.Keller.K assets in 0x67A958/0x67B6B8; final 0x67E350 draws linked space objects and ends at 0x67E7DC.

ranges.label: Arcade ship AI
ranges.evidence: 0x67FF34 selects targets by bearing and distance; 0x680D90 drives arcade movement and obstacle checks through ab_Ship/ab_WorldLine helpers. Final routine ends at 0x681B32.

ranges.label: Arcade world geometry
ranges.evidence: Native diagnostics explicitly name ab_StopPoint_Add, ab_StopLine_Add, ab_WorldLine_Add and ab_WorldImage_Add. This interval includes multiple source units; no single unit label is asserted.

ranges.label: Arcade zones
ranges.evidence: 0x68CC60 renders zone geometry; 0x68D4AC reads zone coordinates/type through TBufEC. Final helper ends at 0x68DF34.

ranges.label: Arcade main loop and screen
ranges.evidence: TfAB VMT at 0x68ED2C inherits TMessageLoopGI. Diagnostics explicitly name ab_MainForm and TfAB.TimerTakt; own final virtual method at 0x69F59C selects arcade music.

ranges.label: Cheats and game-state diagnostics
ranges.evidence: TCheatList VMT at 0x6B1900, weapon/artifact commands and final Events/ShipInfos diagnostic output. Multiple logical facilities are grouped as game infrastructure.

ranges.label: FGInt and RSA
ranges.evidence: Explicit FGInt dynamic-array RTTI at 0x6C5B84; routines manipulate that array type and implement large-integer arithmetic. Final block encoder 0x6C8B30 calls the same arithmetic family and ends at 0x6C8DD1. FGInt versus FGIntRSA internal boundary remains unresolved.

ranges.label: Film object engine and persistence
ranges.evidence: Native TEFilm.ObjAlloc, ObjToNom, NomToObj and RunOrder diagnostics. Final 0x7D1BE8 loads a TEFilm from TBufEC and ends at 0x7D2611.

ranges.label: DirectX drawing helpers
ranges.evidence: 0x7EA62C, 0x7EAC14, 0x7EB798 and 0x7EBBB8 implement the drawing family called from arcade/scene renderers, adjacent to TTextureGR implementations.

ranges.label: Vorbis DLL binding and read adapter
ranges.evidence: 0x7F4BDC calls ov_read into a dynamic byte buffer; 0x7F4CF8 loads libvorbisfile.dll and resolves ov_* exports. This is binding/adapter code, not the decoder implementation.

ranges.label: Sound buffers and playback
ranges.evidence: TSoundBufferControl, TSoundBuffer and TSoundControl VMTs; native wave format/DirectSound buffer setup and Initializing sound diagnostics.

ranges.label: Music playback
ranges.evidence: TMusicUnit and TMusicControl VMTs; TMusicControl inherits TThreadEC and its own methods include 0x7F97AC/0x7F9928. Calls at 0x7F9B0C/0x7F9C6C are used by TfAB's music selection.

ranges.label: Wide-string helpers
ranges.evidence: 0x7FC400 transforms wide strings; final 0x7FD290 copies a specified UTF-16 substring through SetWideStringLength and CopyMemory. Exact EC_Str/WStringUtils boundary is not asserted.

ranges.label: Achievement integration
ranges.evidence: AchievementInfo metadata and TAchievementStats VMT; 0x7FD9AC queries Galaxy/GetPlayer statistics for ASTEROID, PIRATE and PRISONBAIL.

ranges.label: Game text, startup and diagnostics
ranges.evidence: Game-specific Tips, race/occupation and ShipGreetings text in 0x808880, 0x809360 and 0x80F8FC. Final 0x813934 records virtual/physical memory usage through the game logger. Exact Globals/helper-unit boundaries remain unresolved.

ranges.label: Polygon and geometry helpers
ranges.evidence: TPolygon2D VMT at 0x836A64; coordinate/polygon operations at 0x836410, 0x837B24 and 0x838210. Native family classification, not an asserted GR_RectEx/aVector source boundary.
